2610.13708.title: Adaptive DHiSparse: Speculative Decoding over a Load-Adaptive KV Hierarchy
2610.13708.paper_summary: Long-context serving runs out of KV memory before the hardware reaches its useful throughput. HiSparse stores history in host memory and fetches only the selected entries, but it uses one cache budget at every load and does not handle draft-model speculative decoding such as DSpark and DFlash2. We present Adaptive DHiSparse, which supports speculative decoding over hierarchical sparse KV and adapts residency to load. It protects the required working set, retains additional history while GPU memory is spare, and recovers the rest through exact fused retrieval. DSpark and DFlash2 keep their proposal and acceptance rules: queries share missing-row retrieval, draft KV uses a window-bounded ring, and verification staging is reused across layer groups. At 100K context and concurrency 128, GLM-5.3 with DFlash2 delivers 793 output tokens/s per decode GPU, 1.45$\times$ HiSparse and 1.27$\times$ non-speculative adaptive serving. Held to the same latency bounds as HiSparse, it sustains up to 4$\times$ the concurrency and 2.3 to 3.7$\times$ the output, depending on the per-token bound. On DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash at 500K context and concurrency 512, Adaptive DHiSparse with DSpark delivers 1.85$\times$ the output of resident serving with DSpark. In a load step, optional residency reduces host fetches from 14.2% to 1.4% of selected rows at low load and releases memory under pressure.
2610.13708.paper_summary_zh: 長期上下文服務在硬體達到其有效吞吐量之前耗盡了KV內存。HiSparse將歷史存儲在主機內存中，並僅提取選定的條目，但它在每次加載時使用一個緩存預算，並且不處理像DSpark和DFlash2這樣的草稿模型推測解碼。我們提出了自適應DHiSparse，它支持在分層稀疏KV上進行推測解碼，並根據負載調整居留時間。它保護所需的工作集，在GPU內存充足時保留額外的歷史，並通過精確的融合檢索恢復其餘部分。DSpark和DFlash2保持其提案和接受規則：查詢共享缺失行檢索，草稿KV使用窗口限制的環，驗證階段在層組之間重用。在100K上下文和並發128的情況下，GLM-5.3與DFlash2每個解碼GPU提供793個輸出標記/秒，為HiSparse的1.45$\times$和非推測自適應服務的1.27$\times$。在與HiSparse相同的延遲範圍內，它支持高達4$\times$的並發性和2.3到3.7$\times$的輸出，具體取決於每個標記的限制。在500K上下文和並發512的DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash上，自適應DHiSparse與DSpark的輸出是使用DSpark的常駐服務的1.85$\times$。在負載步驟中，可選的居留時間將主機提取從14.2%降低到1.4%的選定行，並在壓力下釋放內存。
